# owner: platform
import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from datetime import date

STUDENT = Student("1", "Doe", "Jo", "A")


def mark(day, status="absent", sid="1"):
    return Mark(sid, date(2026, 9, day), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_sorted_absences(self):
        marks = [mark(8), mark(2), mark(3, "present")]
        text = absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertIn("Jo Doe", text)
        self.assertIn("2 day(s)", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-09-02, 2026-09-08", text)

    def test_other_student(self):
        marks = [mark(2), mark(3, sid="2")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, [mark(2, "late")])
